Reverend Barbara Cooke
After many years in parish ministry, the Rev. Barbara Cooke retired from full-time service in 2016. Since then, she has continued serving congregations through supply work, offering a faithful presence and steady support to churches in times of transition. Known for her thoughtful preaching, warm pastoral care, and deeply reflective sermons, Reverend Cooke often leaves parishioners continuing in conversation about her message long after the service has ended. She and her husband live in Greensboro and have three adult children and seven grandchildren.
